package.name: hexapod_kinematics
package.description: Open-source leg inverse kinematics for Masha hunter gait 15. StepController.loop calls it for gait 5 when use_hexapod_kinematics is true. The flag defaults to false, and every other gait stays on kinematics.so. The controller plug is controller/leg_ik.py. The shared joint zero is fitted to the stand. The step limit is 1.5 times the measured gait-5 peak. The reading plan is PLAN.md. The study path is learning-from-code.md.
